pair_prompt.title: Reason About the Last Valid Index
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver to explain why array.length is the number of elements and what the last valid index should be for the current array.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Array Access Fix
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Check whether the fix uses a safe array index and whether the explanation clearly distinguishes array length from the last valid index.

pair_prompt.title: Trace the Final Loop Iteration
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Have the driver trace the final loop iteration aloud and compare the stopping condition with the last valid array index.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Loop Boundary Choice
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Review whether the stopping condition avoids one extra iteration and whether the explanation matches the valid index range.

pair_prompt.title: Explain the Condition in Plain English
pair_prompt.prompt_text: Ask the driver to read the condition in plain English and explain whether it is checking a value or accidentally assigning one.

peer_review_prompt.title: Review the Conditional Operator
peer_review_prompt.prompt_text: Check whether the condition uses the correct operator and whether the reviewer comment explains why that operator is appropriate.
